=Meeting Title: Weekly Marketing Strategy Meeting

Date: July 22, 2026

Sarah: Good morning everyone. Let's quickly review last week's campaign performance.

Michael: We generated around 2,350 website visitors, which is about 18% higher than the previous week. Most of the traffic came from LinkedIn and organic Google searches.

Emma: The LinkedIn carousel posts performed really well. One of them reached over 12,000 impressions and generated 85 profile visits.

David: That's great. However, our email campaign only had a 21% open rate, which is lower than expected. I think we should test new subject lines.

Sarah: Agreed. Michael, can you prepare three new email subject line variations by Friday?

Michael: Yes, I'll have those ready before Friday afternoon.

Emma: I also suggest increasing our posting frequency from three posts per week to five posts per week.

David: Sounds good. We should also create two short videos explaining our services because video content is getting much higher engagement.

Sarah: Good idea. Emma, can you create a content calendar including those videos?

Emma: Absolutely. I'll finish the calendar by Wednesday.

David: Another issue is that several leads submitted forms but nobody followed up within 24 hours.

Sarah: That's something we need to fix immediately. Let's automate lead notifications so sales receives an email as soon as a form is submitted.

Michael: I can build that workflow in n8n this week.

Sarah: Perfect. Finally, our goal for next week is to generate at least 3,000 website visitors and improve the email open rate to 30%.

Emma: I'll monitor the analytics daily.

Sarah: Great work, everyone. Thanks for joining. Meeting adjourned.
